# HCollapsible

> Independent native disclosure with controlled or default-open state.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.7.0. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HCollapsible` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-collapsible>`.
- Constructor: `HearthCollapsibleElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Controls.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HCollapsible.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Native details disclosure. open controls state; defaultOpen initializes uncontrolled state. Trigger slot must contain noninteractive presentation; do not nest another button inside summary.

## Public API

open, defaultOpen, label, disabled

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    open?: boolean;
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    label: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ open: undefined }
```

### Events

update:open(boolean), change(boolean)

```ts
type Emits = {
    "update:open": [
        open: boolean
    ];
    change: [
        open: boolean
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

trigger, default

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, trigger, body

Use `hearth-collapsible::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HCollapsible } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';

</script>

<template>
  <HCollapsible label="Advanced settings" default-open><p>Application configuration goes here.</p></HCollapsible>
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-collapsible');
Object.assign(element, {
  "label": "Advanced settings",
  "defaultOpen": true
});

element.innerHTML = "<p>Application configuration goes here.</p>"; // Static example markup only; never inject untrusted HTML.

mount.append(element);
```
